answer_1.quote: We formulate human-like chat generation as a latent-variable conditional generation task... The decoder then conditions on both the inferred persona and the conversational context to reconstruct the target response...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate model performance through three primary metrics. Validation Loss measures the model's generalization ability... HumanChatBench assesses alignment with predefined AI characteristics across three key dimensions: CP (Catchphrase Presence), EC (Emoji Consistency), HM (Hobby Mention)... DialogBench uses these following metrics: RC (Relation Classification), SF (Slot Filling)...

answer_4.quote: We employ 30 annotators from diverse backgrounds to identify and refine low-quality responses... The human evaluation of our work was carried out through a meticulously randomized selection of IT professionals. This process ensured a gender-balanced and educationally diverse panel...
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rewrite low-quality utterances and assess model outputs for alignment with human-like behavior.
